verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. `projected_balance` is this display with δ = m²d and with t'_m written as its value `projectedRhs` along a solution (supplied by `anchoredSolve_projected_equation`). The right-hand sides match term by term: pressureCoefficient • n = ((⟪n,Kt⟫ - ⟪n',t⟫ + ⟪n,f⟫)/⟪n,n⟫) • n is the paper's (n_Φ/|n_Φ|²)(n_Φ·𝒦t_m - n'_Φ·t_m + n_Φ·f_m) — same three terms, same signs, scalar-times-vector instead of a vector divided by |n_Φ|², and ⟪n,n⟫ = |n_Φ|². The identity is unconditional in Lean, as in the paper (the m²d(n_Φ·t_m) terms cancel, so the tangency n_Φ·t_m = 0 is not needed). Encoding gap as in eq-p080-1: a real inner-product space against the paper's complex amplitudes. The sentence after the display, multiplying (7.13) by i k m n_Φ, concerns the separate factor i/(km) (`complex_pressure_sign`) and is not part of this block.
